about:
NZK Plastics LLC was founded in 1996 by Nick Karnavas, a Penn State University graduate with a B.S. in Chemical Engineering, in North Versailles Township, Pennsylvania, just outside Pittsburgh. The company began with a single injection molding machine and has since expanded to operate seven machines with clamp tonnages ranging from 50 to 400 tons.

The shop provides custom injection molding services supported by in-house tool development, part design using CAD, rapid prototyping via 3D printing, and secondary operations such as sonic and solvent welding. Its seven molding machines handle single- and multi-cavity molds, and the company reports more than 600 completed projects over 25-plus years.

Customers span automotive, medical device, consumer electronics, and renewable energy sectors. Testimonials cite work for automotive and medical device manufacturers, as well as a consumer electronics client who credited the team with material selection and design modifications that reduced cost.

The company states its mission is to deliver top-quality custom injection molding solutions with a customer-first approach, aiming to be the Pittsburgh region's leading provider of innovative, high-quality injection molding services. It emphasizes a state-of-the-art quality control department and the integration of 3D printing with injection molding for rapid prototyping.
